verdict.rationale: Consensus documents automated searches through its API and an agentic research workflow, so the story's axis applies. The evidence shows no way for users to version, review, or roll back automations. The "stable, versioned JSON endpoints" refers to versioning of the vendor's API, not of user-defined automations, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
